tooltip.carrote.function.carrote_steel_f: Insert Carrote and a Netherite Ingot to forge them; accepts right-clicked items, dropped items, hoppers, and pipes.
tooltip.carrote.function.material_harden: Insert any item to harden it, making it unbreakable and preventing durability loss.
tooltip.carrote.function.mimic_block: Place it and wait five seconds to transform it into the block on its right; block state is copied, but container contents are not.
tooltip.carrote.function.universal_repli: Place it on the left side of an FE-capable device to emulate the device energy and configuration independently without copying items or fluids; sky blue is valid and red is invalid.
